control.description-key: Live SLA countdown bar for cases. Client-side only; reads existing fields and calls nothing (non-premium).

property.name: targetDate
property.description-key: The SLA target datetime the countdown runs to (Resolution or Response target).

property.name: label
property.description-key: Row label shown before the countdown, e.g. Resolution or Response.

property.name: createdOn
property.description-key: Case creation time; the progress-bar baseline. Bind to Created On.

property.name: slaStatus
property.description-key: Current SLA status, shown as a caption. Bind to tavu_slastatus.
